vision.name: Saiyan Rampaging Mastery
vision.text:
[Continuous]: You need 1 less anger to advance a personality level (to a minimum of 4). Your Styled attacks gain "HIT: You may raise your anger 1 level."
POWER: Discard a Styled card with Endurance from your hand to perform a non-Styled physical attack dealing 1 +X stages of damage. X = the amount of Endurance on the discarded card.
vision.note: portrait Set 4 Mastery layout; title strip partly hidden on the sheet, name from filename and S14 P27 reprint
